defects.description: Pricing cards lack subtle shadows or borders, making them look flat against the background; the 'Popular' badge on the Pro card is a simple blue pill without a connecting visual treatment (e.g., top border or elevated shadow) to emphasize it as the recommended choice.

The three pricing cards are not perfectly centered within their container; there appears to be slightly more whitespace on the right side of the Enterprise card compared to the left of the Starter card.
Small UI artifacts (zoom level '43%', canvas toolbar icons) are visible at the bottom edge of the design canvas area, slightly cluttering the presentation.

top_fixes: Add a soft drop shadow or 1px light border to all three pricing cards to lift them off the background and improve depth.

Enhance the 'Pro' popular card with a distinct visual treatment—such as a colored top border (matching the badge), a slight scale-up, or a more prominent shadow—to clearly signal it as the recommended option.
Ensure perfect horizontal centering of the card group and verify that internal padding within each card is identical across all three columns for strict alignment.

manifest.prompt: Create a pricing page for our SaaS product.
